mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN deal_date = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) AS todayDealCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN deal_date = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 END) AS yesterdayDealCount, CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN deal_type = '매매' AND YEAR(deal_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(deal_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN deal_amount END) AS SIGNED) AS avgSalePriceThisMonthManwon, CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN deal_type = '매매' AND deal_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND deal_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN deal_amount END) AS SIGNED) AS avgSalePriceLastMonthManwon, CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN deal_type = '전세' AND YEAR(deal_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(deal_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN deposit_amount END) AS SIGNED) AS avgLeasePriceThisMonthManwon, CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN deal_type = '전세' AND deal_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND deal_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') THEN deposit_amount END) AS SIGNED) AS avgLeasePriceLastMonthManwon FROM house_deal WHERE deal_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND deal_date <= CURDATE()
